title: at new does not name the new row's state, and at green's refusal does not name at red (AE finding 4)
body:
AE found this on 3.5.2. `intent at new` does not say which state the new row is in (`to-write`), and `intent at green` refuses a `to-write` row with "`at.set` is declared only from: red", which names the internal op and not the verb to run.

Fix (b353): `at new` prints `state: <state>` and `next: `intent at <verb> <ST> <AT>``. The `at green` refusal on a row that is not red opens its remedy with "run `intent at red <ST> <AT>` first".

Resolution: Fixed in the b353 batch, landed on main at b15c70157. Released in v3.5.3 (tag v3.5.3 at 8475de825).
